coreRequired.name: Node.js JavaScript Runtime
coreRequired.description: Required to execute Design OS runtime, TypeScript compiler, and MCP server.

coreRequired.name: Package Manager (pnpm / npm)
coreRequired.description: Used for deterministic frozen dependency installation and monorepo script execution.

coreRequired.name: Git Version Control System
coreRequired.description: Required for repository cloning, branch tracking, atomic commits, and safe update detection.

featureRequired.name: TypeScript Compiler
featureRequired.description: Required for monorepo type-checking, composite project builds, and DTCG token contract verification.

featureRequired.name: Vitest Test Runner
featureRequired.description: Required to execute unit, integration, and release gate verification suites.

optional.name: Docker Engine / Container Runtime
optional.description: Optional container runtime for isolated multi-stack execution and containerized deployments.

optional.name: Playwright / Headless Browser Runtime
optional.description: Optional headless browser engine for automated E2E user journeys and truthful UI audit snapshots.

optional.name: .NET SDK (ASP.NET Core)
optional.description: Optional SDK for native build and test verification of generated ASPNET_RAZOR projects.

optional.name: PHP & Composer
optional.description: Optional runtime and package manager for native build and syntax verification of generated LARAVEL_BLADE projects.

operatorFallback.description: If endpoint protection (EDR, AppLocker, SRP, Xcitium) blocks sub-process or command execution, generate an explicit Manual Run Bundle. Human operator executes commands and submits verbatim logs as verified evidence records.
